summary: WebFetch was largely NOT blocked this run, unlike the usual expectation, so this scan is fuller than typical. Verified 38 of 45 weekly-rotation slugs directly on their own official pages: no status changes found. 7 could not be checked (contabo.com/vultr.com returned 403, fluidstack.io returned 429 repeatedly, ovhcloud.com's root redirected without the target page being fetched; deno-deploy and platform-sh are excluded here since they're reported as status_alerts instead). Two material first-party findings: (1) Deno's own blog/docs confirm Deno Deploy is being sunset (~April 2027) after Deno joined Cloudflare; (2) platform.sh now permanently redirects to upsun.com, suggesting it's being folded into the Upsun brand. Both reported as status_alerts for manual review only, not applied. Proposing 3 new candidates (Velda, Cirrascale Inference Platform, Docker Agentic Platform), each confirmed on the vendor's own page. Other leads (AGBCLOUD, Better-PaaS, Partiri Cloud, Out Plane, AppRafter, DeployKit) were NOT proposed: AGBCLOUD's domain failed to resolve, Partiri Cloud showed an inconsistent domain spelling, and the rest lacked a readable first-party page or were too new/unproven. A first-party Heroku post (Feb 2026) shows Salesforce stopped new Enterprise Account contracts while self-serve sign-up continues; doesn't map to one availability value, so it's flagged in prose only, not as a status_alert. No pricing touched; no identity/status fields applied directly.

new_candidates.name: Velda
capabilities: serverless GPU jobs via CLI prefix
new_candidates.summary: Serverless GPU cloud for AI training, batch jobs, and inference. Developers prefix a local command with `vrun` to execute it on hosted B300/H200/H100 GPUs, with per-second billing and no idle-time charges or container image builds required.
new_candidates.best_for: Teams running bursty ML training or batch GPU jobs who want to avoid idle GPU costs and skip image/manifest setup by launching jobs directly from their existing development environment.
new_candidates.change_note: New serverless GPU provider; confirmed directly via its own site (velda.io), not previously in the catalog.

new_candidates.name: Cirrascale Inference Platform
new_candidates.summary: Enterprise AI inference platform that routes workloads across NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, and Tenstorrent accelerators, with governance features such as spend controls, agent guardrails, and private model fine-tuning.
new_candidates.best_for: Enterprises that need multi-vendor hardware flexibility, usage governance, and private fine-tuning for production AI inference, arranged directly with Cirrascale rather than self-serve sign-up.
new_candidates.change_note: Cirrascale's Inference Platform reached production release in September 2026 per its own site; parent company Cirrascale is not previously represented in the catalog.

new_candidates.name: Docker Agentic Platform
capabilities: isolated cloud sandboxes for coding agents
predefined sandbox kits (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Gemini CLI)
new_candidates.summary: Experimental Docker service that runs AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Gemini CLI) in isolated cloud sandboxes that keep running after you disconnect, billed by the second of compute used.
new_candidates.best_for: Developers who want to run AI coding agents in disposable, isolated cloud sandboxes without managing their own sandbox infrastructure, while the product is still in experimental release.
new_candidates.change_note: New experimental product from Docker, publicly released September 24, 2026 per Docker's own docs; not previously represented in the catalog.

status_alerts.rationale: Deno's official announcement (deno.com/blog/cloudflare, Oct 9 2026) says Deno is joining Cloudflare and that Deno Deploy will keep running for about six months before shutting down, with paying customers offered migration support to Cloudflare Workers. Deno's own docs page (docs.deno.com/deploy/, last updated Nov 12 2026) states directly: 'Deno Deploy will be sunset in April 2027. Your existing applications keep running until then.' No exact shutdown date has been published, so effective_date is left null; April 2027 is the best current estimate. Availability is left as general because the sources do not state that new sign-ups are blocked before the sunset date.

platform.sh now sends a 301 Moved Permanently redirect to upsun.com (observed directly this run). Upsun's own homepage is live and describes itself as 'the software factory for AI-human workflows,' with no mention of Platform.sh in the portion read, but the permanent redirect from the Platform.sh root domain to Upsun is itself first-party evidence that Platform.sh is being consolidated into the Upsun brand. Both 'platform-sh' and 'upsun' are currently separate active catalog entries; this needs manual review to decide whether platform-sh should be marked as merged/rebranded into upsun rather than left as an independently active provider.
